entries.summary: The Mi-24D was a modified version of the Soviet Mi-24A attack helicopter. During the first years of operation, several shortcomings were revealed, including a bad cockpit layout and the low effectiveness of the A-12.7 machine gun. Consequently, the helicopter was given separate tandem cockpits, and the A-12.7 was replaced with a new four-barrel, 12.7 mm YakB machine gun mounted in a remotely controlled turret beneath the operator's position. The new modification was also planned to receive new Shturm-V ATGMs, but their development was delayed. Therefore…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉Puma u14
entries.summary: In the late 2010s, the German Armed Forces (Bundeswehr) began developing an upgrade program for its Puma infantry fighting vehicles to meet the requirements of the NATO Very High Readiness Joint Task Force (VJTF) rapid response force configuration. The program included installing Spike-LR ATGMs, improving communication systems, and making a number of minor changes. In 2021, the decision was made to modernize 40 vehicles, which are expected to be completed by 2023. Two units equipped with the upgraded IFVs were to join the German component of the VJTF ta…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉Lorelei
entries.summary: As World War II approached, Belgium found itself without an adequate fleet of large ships. The newest ship was the sloop Zinnia, which was completed in 1915. The navy needed a suitable vessel to counter the German small fleet. The new sloop Artevelde was laid down in March 1939. In peacetime, she would have been used to protect fishing operations and serve as a royal yacht. In wartime, she would function as an escort and a minelayer. The sloop was captured by the Germans on May 18, 1940, and was soon renamed the Lorelei. The Germans inspected the ship a…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉Palmaria
entries.summary: The Palmaria is an Italian self-propelled gun developed from the SP70 program. OTO Melara engineers began working on the SPG in 1977. They installed a 155 mm howitzer in a rotating turret on the chassis of the export OF-40 tank. The first Palmaria prototype was presented in 1981, and mass production began the following year. The SPG was intended for the export market, and Libya and Nigeria became its primary customers, receiving a total of 187 vehicles. Additionally, Argentina purchased 25 Palmaria turrets, which were installed on TAM chassis. Productio…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉Admiral Scheer
entries.summary: The Admiral Scheer was the second ship of the Deutschland-class cruisers, commonly referred to as the "pocket battleships" because of their large guns and small size. They were designed to comply with the Treaty of Versailles, which limited the naval power of Germany after World War I. Each successive ship of the class was built with increased armour as a result of the easing of the tonnage restrictions imposed on Germany over time, with Admiral Scheer having more armour than Deutschland but less than Admiral Graf Spee. Admiral Scheer was laid down on 2…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉MiG-21 2000
entries.summary: The MiG-21-2000 was a modernization program developed by Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI) in the 1990s for the MiG-21bis fighter. The program aimed to transform the aging aircraft into a modern combat platform by replacing its avionics entirely. Russia had been negotiating MiG-21 modernization programs with many countries, including Romania. Thus, the announcement of a Romanian-Israeli agreement on the same subject in early 1993 came as an unpleasant surprise. IAI and Elbit were responsible for preparing the documentation and equipment kits for the upg…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉Hunter AFV
entries.summary: In the early 2000s, the Singapore Armed Forces needed to replace their aging M113 Ultra vehicles, which had weak armor and outdated electronics. In 2006, the Defence Science and Technology Agency (DSTA) began developing a new combat vehicle in response. In 2017, ST Kinetics won the contract to build and develop the vehicle. The first prototype of the vehicle, named the Hunter, was unveiled at the Singapore Airshow in 2018. Deliveries of the Hunter AFV variant, equipped with a 30-mm Bushmaster II cannon and Spike missiles, began to the army as early as 2…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉M-346FA
entries.summary: The Aermacchi M-346 is an Italian two-seat trainer and combat aircraft. Originally developed by the Yakovlev Design Bureau, it was designed to train pilots of modern fighter jets and perform certain combat missions. Development of the aircraft began in the early 1990s as part of a program to create a new training complex to replace the Czechoslovakian L-39ZA, which could no longer adequately prepare pilots for modern aircraft. In 1993, the Italian company Aermacchi joined the project. However, the collaboration ended in 2000 due to disagreements about t…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉MAS 429
entries.summary: The MAS 429 was one of three Italian MAS 427-class artillery patrol boats. Built in 1919 at the Societa Veneziana Automobili Navali shipyard in Venice, the boats had wooden hulls and no armor protection. The main armament was a 76 mm Ansaldo naval gun of the 1916 model. While such armament was formidable for a small naval craft, firing the gun at full speed was nearly impossible due to its strong recoil and the boat's heavy rolling. The MAS 429 differed from the other boats in its class because it had a shorter hull, resulting in lower displacement. Alt…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉Leopard 2RI
entries.summary: In 2007, IBD Deisenroth Engineering presented the Leopard 2 Evolution. Compared to the Leopard 2A4, this tank offered enhanced firepower, protection, and situational awareness without requiring a new turret, unlike the Leopard 2A5. Additionally, all new components could be installed independently, allowing potential customers to select only the elements they deemed necessary. Over the years, the modernization package was improved further and gained customers. In 2013, Indonesia ordered 103 vehicles, 61 of which were to be delivered as Leopard 2RIs. Base…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉 L-39ZA/ART Albatros
entries.summary: The Aero L-39ZA/ART Albatros was a version of the L-39ZA with new Elbit electronics, built for the Royal Thai Air Force. Thailand placed an order for 36 aircraft in the early 1990s, and they were delivered by October 1993. By April 1997, an additional four aircraft had been delivered. The aircraft were operated by the 401st and 411th Squadrons, whose pilots trained for fighter and attacker missions, as well as search-and-rescue operations. The 401st Squadron's aircraft were replaced by KAI T-50THs in 2018. The 411th Squadron's L-39ZA/ARTs made their fin…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉JDS Ujishima (MSC-655)
entries.summary: The YMS-1-class, JDS Ujishima (MSC-655) (うじしま), formerly USS Condor (YMS-192), was a US-built minesweeper launched in 1942. She served in the Battle of the Atlantic during World War II, before conducting occupation and minesweeping duties around Japan after the war. Placed in reserve, she was recommissioned during the Korean War before being loaned to Japan in 1955 under the Mutual Defense Assistance Program to help rebuild the country's maritime self-defence capability. Serving with the JMSDF for roughly eleven years, Ujishima was returned to the US Na…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉NOMADS
entries.summary: The NOMADS (NatiOnal Maneuver Air Defence System) is a short-range air defense system developed by Kongsberg Defense & Aerospace (KDA) for the Norwegian Army. In October 2019, the Norwegian Army requested the development of a short-range air defense system mounted on an all-terrain chassis and equipped with an AESA radar and modern missiles. KDA took the radar, rangefinder, cameras, and other electronics from the NASAMS system and mounted them, along with the missiles, on the chassis of the German ACSV G5 tracked vehicle. There are two missiles to choos…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉M60A1 Predator
entries.summary: In the mid-1970s, the M60A1 tank underwent a modernization program aimed at improving engine reliability. The upgraded tanks entered service with the U.S. Army in the late 1970s as the M60A1 (RISE). Several years later, the tanks were outfitted with additional equipment, including passive night vision devices for the gunner, commander, and driver, as well as smoke grenade launchers. In the late 1980s, they were fitted with the ERA to improve protection against chemical rounds. These upgrades resulted in the tank receiving the designation M60A1 RISE (P),…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉M1A2 (Trophy-HV)
entries.summary: The US Army's experience with operating armored vehicles and developing anti-tank weapons led them to consider equipping M1A2 Abrams tanks with active protection systems. The Israeli Trophy-HV system, developed by Rafael Advanced Defense Systems, was chosen for testing. The U.S. Army later decided to equip its tank units stationed in Europe with the system. Up to 261 Abrams tanks were planned for modernization, which is enough to equip four armored brigade combat teams. In June 2018, Leonardo DRS, Rafael's American partner, received a contract to supply…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉AJS37 (Early)
entries.summary: The AJS37 Viggen is an updated version of the Swedish AJ37 ground-attack aircraft. "AJS" stands for "attack-jakt-spaning", which translates to "attack-fighter-reconnaissance", and "Viggen" means "lightning" in Swedish. In the early 1990s, the Swedish Air Force decided to extend the service life of the AJ, SH, and SF 37 aircraft by modernizing them to enable the AJ aircraft to conduct reconnaissance missions. Between 1993 and 1998, 48 aircraft received upgrades, including two additional pylons for air-to-ground missiles, expanded anti-ship armament to in…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉M1A2 SEPv3
entries.summary: The M1A2 SEPv3 Abrams is the third iteration of the tank to undergo modernization under the System Enhancement Package (SEP) program. The upgrade aimed to enhance the vehicle's survivability, reliability, and combat effectiveness, and to integrate it into modern digital battlefield management systems. The tank received several upgrades as part of the modernization, including the Ammunition Data Link (ADL) system for programming advanced ammunition; improved thermal sights under the Improved Forward Looking Infrared (IFLIR) program; the CROWS remote weap…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉F-14D
entries.summary: The F-14D Super Tomcat was the final and most advanced production variant of the Grumman F-14 carrier-based interceptor. Development of the variant featuring new General Electric F110-GE-400 engines began in the mid-1980s due to chronic reliability issues with the standard TF30 engines. Four F-14A aircraft were converted into prototypes, and the F-14B with the new engines participated in powerplant testing. The maiden flight of the first F-14B with F110-GE-400 engines occurred on September 29, 1986. The first D variant prototype, PA-1/161865, took to th…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉F-101C
entries.summary: The McDonnell F-101C Voodoo is an American supersonic fighter that was originally developed as a long-range escort interceptor. Its history began in 1946 when the U.S. Air Force issued a requirement for a long-range escort fighter to accompany bombers. McDonnell responded with the XF-88 project. The first of two prototypes flew on October 20, 1948. Although the aircraft demonstrated good maneuverability, it had an insufficient thrust-to-weight ratio and limited range. This led to the program's cancellation in 1950. However, everything changed with the o…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉USS Gridley
entries.summary: The USS Gridley (DD-380) was a United States Navy destroyer and the lead ship of her class. She was laid down on June 3, 1935; launched on December 1, 1936; and commissioned on June 24, 1937. She was named in honor of Civil War-era Captain Charles Vernon Gridley. This class differed from the previous Mahan class in that it had enhanced torpedo armament but one fewer main battery mount. The destroyer actively participated in battles in the Pacific from the start of World War II. Although the Gridley was not at Pearl Harbor when it was attacked, she arriv…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉USS North Carolina
entries.summary: The USS North Carolina (BB-55) was the lead ship of the US Navy's North Carolina class of battleships. She was laid down on October 27, 1937; launched on June 13, 1940; and commissioned on April 9, 1941. The design of the battleships in this class began in the early 1930s. They were planned to have combat characteristics equal to the upper limits of the 1922 Washington Naval Treaty, but these parameters were adjusted to comply with the 1936 Second London Naval Treaty. After the Senate had approved the designs, it was discovered that Japan had refused to…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉T-90M (Arena-M)
entries.summary: One of the ways the T-90M was modernized was by installing an active protection system. In April 2023, a patent was published for a T-90M with the Arena-M APS. Compared to the earlier version displayed on the T-72B3, the new system differs in the placement of its modules, which fit within the T-90M's external dimensions, and in the number of countermeasures. The first prototype was presented in February 2025. After successfully completing trials in June 2026, production of the T-90M with the Arena-M APS began. The T-90M (Arena-M) was introduced in Updat…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉Yak-130
entries.summary: The Yak-130, NATO reporting name "Mitten", is an advanced two-seat trainer and light combat aircraft. It was developed by the Yakovlev Design Bureau to prepare pilots for modern fighter aircraft and is capable of carrying out limited combat missions. Development began in the early 1990s as part of a program to create a new advanced training system to replace the Czechoslovak L-39ZA, which could no longer adequately prepare pilots for modern combat aviation. In 1993, the Italian company Aermacchi joined the project. However, the partnership ended several…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉MiG-29KR (9-41R)
entries.summary: Work on the MiG-29K, a carrier-based fighter aircraft, began in the late 1970s when the Soviet Navy required a supersonic aircraft to operate from aircraft-carrying cruisers. To test this concept, the MiG-29KVP prototype with reinforced landing gear and an arrestor hook was built in 1982, proving that the aircraft could take off from a ski jump. The production aircraft was based on the promising MiG-29M (Product 9-15). It received a larger folding wing, a reinforced structure, the multifunctional Zhuk radar, a new cockpit, and an expanded arsenal of gui…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉Chervona Ukraina
entries.summary: The Chervona Ukraina was a light cruiser that was laid down as a Svetlana-class ship (the lead ship of the Black Sea cruiser series) under the name Admiral Nakhimov on October 18, 1913, at the Nikolaev Shipyard. The cruiser's hull was launched on October 19, 1915. In early 1919, the cruiser fell into the hands of the French interventionists. The following year, the Armed Forces of Southern Russia towed her to Odessa, where she remained until the evacuation. In February 1920, the ship was towed back to Nikolaev. She remained moored at the shipyard until …

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉J-22M1A
entries.summary: In the late 1960s, Romania and Yugoslavia considered jointly developing a subsonic, multipurpose attack aircraft capable of intercepting low-flying targets. The aircraft's requirements were strict: it had to be simple and made from local components. It also had to be capable of landing on unprepared airfields, reliable, and easy to maintain. On May 20, 1971, the two countries signed a joint development agreement. Both the Romanian and Yugoslav prototypes made their first flight on October 31, 1974. Yugoslav pre-production J-22s began to roll out in late…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉IA.58A Pucara
entries.summary: In August 1966, the Argentine State Aviation Factory (DINFIA) started designing a new counterinsurgency aircraft for the Argentine Air Force. For this project, the factory selected a low-wing design featuring two turboprop engines and a T-tail. On August 20, 1969, the first prototype, still known at the time as the IA.58 Delfín, took to the skies for the first time. The aircraft was soon renamed the IA.58 Pucará. The second prototype, equipped with Turbomeca Astazou engines, flew for the first time on September 6, 1970. The first production aircraft was…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉Scimitar Mk.2
entries.summary: In 2009, BAE Systems began upgrading the FV107 Scimitar reconnaissance vehicle for the British Army, applying lessons learned from operations in Afghanistan. As part of the modernization process, the gasoline engine was replaced with a Cummins BTA diesel engine and the manual transmission was replaced with an automatic one. The vehicle also received improved mine and ballistic protection, new crew seats, and an air conditioning system. Additional armor kits and slat armor could be added as needed. The upgraded vehicle was designated the Scimitar Mk.2, a…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉FIAT 6616UB
entries.summary: The Fiat 6616 is an Italian armoured car developed as a joint venture between Fiat and OTO Melara in the early 1970s. In 1977, as tensions between Somalia and neighbouring Ethiopia reached a boiling point over the disputed region of Ogaden, Somalia ordered 30 Fiat 6616 armoured cars armed with 20 mm MK 20 autocannons from Italy. However, they would only arrive in 1978–1979, after the conclusion of the Ogaden War. In 1991, at the conclusion of a 10-year war of independence, the northern part of Somalia declared independence as the Republic of Somaliland.…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉IAR-81C (DB 605)
entries.summary: The IAR-80 was the most-produced Romanian fighter of the Second World War, with roughly 450 built. It was designed by the Romanian state-run company Industria Aeronautică Română (IAR). The most advanced variant produced during the war was the IAR-81C, which began production in 1942. Beginning in mid-1941, recognising the limitations of the underpowered IAR 14 K IV c 32 engine, IAR began searching for a new powerplant, primarily from Germany. The first engine tested was a Daimler-Benz DB 601 Aa taken from a Bf 109 E, which was fitted to IAR-80 airframe N…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉Oktyabrskaya Revolutsiya
entries.summary: The Gangut was a Sevastopol-class battleship of the Russian Imperial Fleet. She was laid down on June 16, 1909; launched on October 20, 1911; and commissioned in late December 1914. In August 1915, the Gangut and the Sevastopol sailed into the Baltic Sea to provide cover for a mine-laying operation. Due to bad weather, both battleships sustained minor underwater damage. In late October 1915, sailors on the Gangut spontaneously revolted, and the uprising quickly escalated into riots. The battleships remained moored off Helsinki in 1916 and 1917, not sail…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉Hawk T Mk 1A (FRP)
entries.summary: In the 1990s and 2000s, as the Hawk T Mk 1 and Mk 1A fuselage lifespan was nearing its end, the Royal Air Force carried out a large-scale Fuselage Replacement Program (FRP). This program involved replacing the entire central and rear sections of the aircraft. Despite some visual differences, the Hawk's performance characteristics remained unchanged. The Hawk T Mk 1A remained in service until the early 2010s, when it was phased out alongside the basic Hawk T Mk 1. The Hawk T Mk 1A (FRP) was introduced in Update 2.59 "Sky Odyssey". It is a small, lightwei…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉Arjun Mk 1
entries.summary: The MBT Arjun Mk I (Hindi: एम बी टी अर्जुन मार्क I) is an indigenously developed Indian main battle tank in service with the Indian Army. The tank is named for Arjuna (Hindi: अर्जुन), the archer prince who is the protagonist of the Indian epic Mahābhārata (Sanskrit: महाभारतम्). The development of the Arjun was slow and arduous. Beginning in the wake of the 1971 Bangladesh Liberation War, India issued a requirement for a new main battle tank to replace the Vijayantā (Hindi: विजयंता) and supplement the T-72. The project was funded in 1974, and development…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉F-16XL
entries.summary: Following the success of the F-16, General Dynamics began exploring ways to increase the fighter jet's range and payload capacity without compromising its core strengths. In 1977, the company started working on the SCAMP (Supersonic Cruise and Maneuver Prototype) project under Harry Hillaker's leadership. One of the project's key objectives was to improve the aircraft's performance at supersonic speeds. During development, General Dynamics drew on NASA research and moved away from the original wing design of the F-16. They replaced it with a cranked-arr…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉 CA-27 Mk.32
entries.summary: After the CA-27 Sabre was taken out of service with the Royal Australian Air Force, 18 fighters were sent to Malaysia starting in 1969. Delivery of the aircraft was completed in 1972, and they all served with the 11th Squadron of the Royal Malaysian Air Force. In 1976, five of the aircraft were transferred to the Indonesian Air Force. The remaining CA-27s were decommissioned and replaced by the Northrop F-5 by 1978. The Malaysian CA-27 Mk.32 was introduced in Update 2.59 "Sky Odyssey" as a part of the Japanese aviation research tree. It is the heaviest …

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉Hawk T Mk 1A
entries.summary: In 1964, the Royal Air Force requested the development of a fast trainer aircraft to replace the obsolete Folland Gnat. The SEPECAT Jaguar was initially considered for this role but was ultimately deemed too complex and expensive. In 1968, therefore, Hawker Siddeley began a private venture to create an aircraft that could be used for training or combat, depending on the customer’s requirements. In 1970, the Royal Air Force became interested in the aircraft and specified requirements for it. In March 1972, an order for 175 aircraft was signed. The protot…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉Wildcat HMA2
entries.summary: The development of the AW159 Wildcat was driven by the Army Air Corps' and the Royal Navy's need to replace their Lynx and Army Gazelle helicopters. Development began in the 1990s. AgustaWestland was tasked with creating the "Future Lynx" platform, either by deeply modernizing the existing fleet or developing a new aircraft. By the mid-2000s, the first approach was deemed unpromising, and work began on a new Lynx. This helicopter was later redesignated the AW159 Wildcat. The new helicopter was equipped with modern systems, including a glass cockpit, upg…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉FK-2000
entries.summary: The FK-2000 is a Chinese short- and medium-range air defense system developed by the China Aerospace Science and Industry Corporation (CASIC) for export. It was first unveiled at the 2021 Zhuhai Air Show. Mounted on an 8×8 all-terrain chassis, the system has a turret behind the cab that houses the radar and armament. The armament consists of two 30-mm cannons and 12 launchers. The system can intercept aircraft as well as targets such as cruise missiles or drones. Buyers of the FK-2000 include the UAE, Chad, Ethiopia, Sudan, and Turkmenistan. Since 2025,…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉HMS Lion
entries.summary: HMS Lion was to be the lead ship of a class of six battleships built for the Royal Navy in 1939. The class was born out of the "Escalation Clause" of the Second London Naval Treaty of 1936, which nullified any prior tonnage restrictions imposed by the treaty, as well as those established by the preceding Washington and First London Naval Treaties, triggered in 1937 after Japan refused to ratify the treaty. As the then-latest battleship of the RN, the King George V class, was already late in construction, a decision was made to build a new battleship cla…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉PLZ45
entries.summary: The PLZ45 is a Chinese self-propelled gun intended for export. In the 1980s, China began reducing its military spending to focus on economic development. To keep pace with military technology, China developed equipment for export alongside equipment intended for the domestic market. Thus, in 1986, the development of an export self-propelled gun equipped with a 155mm gun based on the Austrian GHN45 howitzer began. The first prototype was completed in 1988 and soon showcased at an international defense exhibition in Beijing. The first live-fire exercises …

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉 EMBT
entries.summary: The EMBT (European Main Battle Tank) was shown in 2018 at the Eurosatory exhibition. It was made by KNDS (the fusion between KMW and Nexter Defense Systems) as a gap project for the MGCS (Main Ground Combat System) programme. The programme started in 2017 with the idea of merging the two MBTs of both France and Germany in order to offer an alternative for foreign customers and demonstrate that collaboration between German and French manufacturers was possible. In early 2018, the French Leclerc S1 turret was merged with a German Leopard 2A7 hull at the N…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉J-16
entries.summary: The J-16 is a two-seat, multirole Chinese fighter-bomber developed by the Shenyang Aircraft Corporation. It is based on the J-11BS, which was derived from the Soviet Su-27UB. The J-16's prototype made its maiden flight on October 17, 2011. By late April 2014, the Chinese Air Force had received its first batch of production J-16s. The aircraft's most notable feature is its AESA radar, which can detect aerial targets from long distances and guide weapons against multiple ground or naval targets simultaneously. The J-16 is also reportedly capable of intera…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉ARL-44 Bayard
entries.summary: The ARL-44 was a French heavy tank that was developed shortly before the conclusion of World War II. Only sixty units were ever manufactured, beginning in 1949. The vehicle was unimpressive and saw only limited service. The tank was decommissioned in 1953. The ARL-44 is undoubtedly based on an earlier French heavy tank design. The hull is long but narrow, built for crossing deep trenches during wartime. The covered suspension, with its many small road wheels, is the most evident indication of its Char B1 heavy tank ancestry; it is virtually identical to…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉LCM(65)
entries.summary: In 1938, the British Army required a craft to land tanks directly on beaches, prompting the development of the first Motor Landing Craft, later standardised as the LCM Mark I. Designed to carry a light tank and unload rapidly via a hinged bow ramp, its prototypes were ready by 1938–1939, with trials completed just before World War II. In 1941, Higgins Industries adapted the design into an all-steel version, the LCM(3). From 1942, U.S. shipyards mass-produced these craft for the Navy and Army. Thousands served in North Africa, Sicily, Normandy, and the P…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉SE.203 Aquilon 203
entries.summary: The de Havilland Sea Venom was a naval variant of the regular Venom, built for the Royal Navy to operate from aircraft carriers. The first units began to enter service in 1951, but it was eventually replaced by the de Havilland Sea Vixen from 1959 onward, with the final units withdrawn in 1970. France was already building Vampires under licence and, as they needed a new aircraft for naval service, acquired a licence to produce the Sea Venom. This became the first jet-powered aircraft used by the French Navy, under the name Aquilon. The airframe was prod…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉 EMBT
entries.summary: The EMBT (European Main Battle Tank) was shown in 2018 at the Eurosatory exhibition. It was made by KNDS (the fusion between KMW and Nexter Defense Systems) as a gap project for the MGCS (Main Ground Combat System) programme. The programme started in 2017 with the idea of merging the two MBTs of both France and Germany in order to offer an alternative for foreign customers and demonstrate that collaboration between German and French manufacturers was possible. In early 2018, the French Leclerc S1 turret was merged with a German Leopard 2A7 hull at the N…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉Ar 234 B-2 (WB 151)
entries.summary: The Ar 234 B-2 was the world's first jet bomber, which was developed by the German company Arado. The B-2 was designed as a bomber, whereas earlier variants were reconnaissance aircraft. The prototype made its first flight on March 12, 1944. The fuel tanks occupied virtually the entire fuselage, so bombs were mounted on external racks. The fixed tail armament installed on earlier versions was removed because it was ineffective. The aircraft was also equipped with a periscope that allowed the pilot to switch to the bomb sight; however, the image was inve…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉Algerie
entries.summary: Algérie was a heavy cruiser and the sole ship of her class. She was the most advanced heavy cruiser in the French Navy. She was laid down on March 19, 1931, launched on May 21, 1932, and commissioned on June 15, 1932. Designed in response to the Italian Zara-class cruisers, the Algérie differed radically from all previous French heavy cruiser designs. Her armor scheme incorporated a full armor belt, and she was fitted with state-of-the-art steam superheating boilers that increased her speed. New 100-mm dual-purpose guns were also installed. Her name als…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉R-310
entries.summary: The R-310 was a German minesweeper belonging to the special escort R-301 series. This series consisted of twelve "R-boat" minesweepers (German: Geleit-Räumboot). One of the main differences between this series and earlier R-boats was its three-shaft propulsion system; most others had two shafts. Another notable difference was the installation of two 533-mm torpedo tubes. Thanks to these additions, the ships could not only lay minefields, but also protect convoys from large enemy vessels. Commissioned on June 10, 1944, the R-310 joined the 21st Mine Swee…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉H145M
entries.summary: The Airbus H145M is a military version of the EC645 T2, a civilian helicopter developed by Airbus Helicopters. The helicopter received EASA certification in 2015 and was officially cleared for operation that May. The Bundeswehr became the first customer for the H145M, receiving their first helicopters in 2015. Germany ordered a total of 15 helicopters for the 64th Helicopter Squadron, which is based in Laupheim. One of the primary roles of the new helicopters is to support special operations forces. The H145M soon attracted interest from other countries…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉 Osa-AKM
entries.summary: In 1991, the Hellenic Army inquired with the recently unified Germany about purchasing most of the military equipment of the former East Germany. As the Bundeswehr found no use for Eastern Bloc vehicles, the deal was signed that year, resulting in large batches of vehicles being delivered from 1992 to 1994. Among these were the Osa-AKM (9K33M2) SPAA systems. As of 2024, 38 Osa-AKMs remained in service with the Hellenic Army, with some being sold to Armenia that year. The Greek Osa-AKM was introduced in Update 2.59 "Sky Odyssey" as part of the Israeli te…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉 Leopard 2HEL
entries.summary: In 1998, the Greek Armed Forces held a tank procurement tender, evaluating the Leopard 2A5, the M1A2 Abrams, the Leclerc, the T-84, the Challenger 2E, and the T-80U. The Leopard 2A5 was selected as the preferred option, but in 2003, Greece decided to acquire a more advanced version of the tank. As part of negotiations with Germany, they developed the Leopard 2HEL based on the Leopard 2A6. A total of 170 tanks were planned for production. The first 30 vehicles were manufactured in Germany, and the remaining 140 were assembled in Greece. The Leopard 2HEL …

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉 Tor-M1
entries.summary: In 1991, the Hellenic Army inquired with the recently unified Germany about purchasing most of the military equipment of the former East Germany. As the Bundeswehr found no use for Eastern Bloc vehicles, the deal was signed that year, resulting in large batches of vehicles being delivered from 1992 to 1994. Among these were the 9K331 "Tor-M1" SPAA systems. As of 2024, 21 Tor-M1s remain in service with the Hellenic Army, with another four being operated by the Hellenic Air Force. The Greek Tor-M1 was introduced in Update 2.59 "Sky Odyssey" as part of the…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉 F-102A
entries.summary: After the U.S. Air Force withdrew the F-102A from service, these interceptors were offered for export. There were two buyers: Greece and Turkey. In 1969, the Royal Hellenic Air Force received 24 aircraft, 19 of which were single-seat variants. The aircraft saw relatively uneventful service until 1977, when they were replaced by the Mirage F1. The Greek F-102A was introduced in Update 2.59 "Sky Odyssey" as a part of the Israeli Aviation Tree. This fighter is notable for its weak miniguns; that forces it to heavily rely on radar-guided AIM-26 missiles to …

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉 F-84G-16-RE
entries.summary: After the end of the Greek Civil War in 1949, the Royal Hellenic Air Force was in need of modernisation, primarily due to threats from communist neighbours. Because of this, Greece joined NATO in 1952 and received much-needed military aid. Among these were 200 Republic F-84G Thunderjets, which were delivered from 1952–1955 and became the RHAF's first jet fighters. The F-84G would serve with the RHAF until 1960, when it was replaced by the Canadair Sabre 2. The Greek F-84G was introduced in Update 2.59 "Sky Odyssey" as part of the Israeli tree and is fun…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉 F-86E(M)
entries.summary: With the dawn of the jet age, Greece ordered 120 refurbished F-86E(M) Sabres. These were CL-13 Mk.4s retrofitted by North American. The Mk.4 version was derived from the Mk.2 variant and had only minor differences. The first F-86E(M) arrived in Greece in 1954 being previously used by the Royal Canadian Air Force. In 1964, the aircraft's upper surfaces were painted in NATO-standard camouflage. The Sabres were replaced by F-5As in 1965. The Greek F-86E(M) was introduced in Update 2.59 "Sky Odyssey", as part of the Israeli aviation research tree. The Greek…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉 A-7H
entries.summary: In the early 1970s, the Hellenic Air Force began searching for a replacement for its F-84F Thunderstreak fighter jets. The A-7 caught their attention thanks to its good combat radius and strike capabilities, as well as its relatively low purchase price and simple maintenance. Between 1975 and 1980, Greece acquired 60 A-7H aircraft, a variant of the A-7E without an aerial refueling system. Greek pilots valued the aircraft for its simplicity and flight performance. However, Greek A-7Hs never saw combat, and seven aircraft were lost in non-combat incidents…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉 Mirage F1CG
entries.summary: As the F-102A became obsolete—an aircraft that did not boast impressive performance even at the time of purchase—the Hellenic Air Force turned to France to procure Mirage F1C fighters. A new version, the Mirage F1CG, was developed specifically for Greece, primarily differing in its available armament. The order was placed in 1974, and deliveries began the following year. The Hellenic Air Force received a total of 40 single-seat fighters. They were only used in mock dogfights with Turkish aircraft. For instance, on June 18, 1992, a Mirage crashed while a…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉 F-4E AUP Phantom II
entries.summary: In 1972, Greece ordered 36 new F-4E Phantom IIs. Deliveries began just two years later. In the early 1990s, additional F-4E and RF-4E aircraft were purchased from the Air National Guard and the Luftwaffe. Following the German ICE program, the Greeks also wanted to modernize their aircraft in a similar manner. To this end, on August 11, 1997, a contract was signed between the German company DASA and Hellenic Aerospace Industry to modernize 39 aircraft to the F-4E Peace Icarus 2000 (AUP) standard. The first upgraded aircraft arrived in Greece in December …

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉 Mirage 2000-5EG
entries.summary: The Mirage 2000-5EG is a variant of the French Mirage 2000 fighter jet that was developed for the Hellenic Air Force. In 1985, Greece signed a contract with France for 40 Mirage 2000 aircraft: 36 single-seat Mirage 2000EGs and 4 two-seat Mirage 2000BGs. The first aircraft were delivered in 1988 and were assigned to the 331st and 332nd squadrons at Tanagra air base. In the early 2000s, the Hellenic Air Force upgraded part of its fleet to the 2000-5 Mk.2 standard and ordered an additional 15 aircraft, increasing the size of the Greek Mirage 2000 fleet to …

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉 Rafale EG
entries.summary: The Rafale EG is a variant of the French Rafale C fighter jet that was developed for the Hellenic Air Force. In January 2021, Greece signed a contract with Dassault Aviation for 18 Rafale fighters: six newly built aircraft and 12 that were previously operated by the French Air and Space Force. The aircraft were intended to replace the aging Mirage 2000EG/BG. In September of that year, Greece ordered an additional six Rafales, bringing the total order to 24. The first six Rafales arrived at Tanagra Air Base in January 2022, and the aircraft officially en…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉RN Giulio Cesare
entries.summary: RN Giulio Cesare was the second ship of the Conte di Cavour-class built for the Regia Marina. She was laid down on June 25, 1910; launched on October 15, 1911; and completed in November 1913. She joined the Royal Italian Navy on June 7, 1914. During World War I, the battleship repeatedly went to sea but did not participate in combat operations. The dreadnoughts were only permitted to risk combat in the event of an encounter with enemy battleships. In all other cases, Italy protected its capital ships. From 1933 to 1937, the battleship underwent comprehe…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉 PzH 2000
entries.summary: At the start of the 21st century, the Italian Army's self-propelled artillery brigade primarily consisted of the ageing M109L SPH, and therefore a decision was made to procure a replacement. On 17 December 2002, a consortium led by OTO Melara signed a contract with the German company KMW for a licence to produce 70 Panzerhaubitze 2000s for the Italian Army. The vehicle was produced locally and delivered between 2004–2008. Six of the vehicles were later donated to Ukraine in 2022, leaving 64 in service with the Italian Army as of 2026. Introduced in Upda…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉Ki-93-I Ko
entries.summary: The Rikugun Ki-93-I Ko was a Japanese twin-engine heavy fighter and ground-attack aircraft developed by the Army Aerotechnical Research Institute as a heavily armed aircraft capable of engaging enemy bombers and ground targets. Development began in 1941, with the design later transferred to the First Army Air Arsenal at Tachikawa, where it was refined around two Mitsubishi Ha-214 radial engines and a heavily armoured crew compartment. Two variants were planned: the Ki-93-I Ko for bomber interception, armed with a 57 mm Ho-402 cannon and two 20 mm Ho-5 c…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉Harimau
entries.summary: The Harimau, also known as the Modern Medium Weight Tank (MMWT), is a light tank jointly developed by Indonesia and Turkey. Development began in May 2015 to provide the Indonesian Army with a modern, highly mobile armoured vehicle to replace its ageing AMX-13s. The first prototype was built in Turkey and unveiled at the 2016 Indo Defence Expo, featuring the Belgian-made Cockerill 3105 modular turret. Production of the hull began in February 2020 under FNSS, with the production version (known as Harimau/Kaplan) revealed in 2021. One prototype underwent v…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉 A-4PTM
entries.summary: After the U.S. Navy decommissioned some of its A-4 Skyhawks, Malaysia expressed interest in purchasing the surplus aircraft. Thus, in 1979, Malaysia placed an order for 25 A-4Cs and 63 A-4Ls. The plan was to upgrade all the aircraft to a single standard upon delivery, but due to financial constraints, only 43 single-seat and six two-seat A-4s were included in the upgrade program. This modification was designated the A-4PTM (Persekutuan Tanah Melayu, or Malay Federation). The upgrades primarily consisted of installing a new Saab RGS-2A lead-computing gun…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉PT-809
entries.summary: The PT-9-class, PT-9 (PT-809) was a British Dark-class fast patrol boat purchased by the JMSDF in 1954 as a reference vessel for evaluating fast-patrol technology and composite construction methods. Built by Saunders-Roe in the United Kingdom, it was the only Dark-class boat operated by Japan and was commissioned in September 1957. Powered by two Napier Deltic diesel engines, it could reach 40 knots and was armed with a single 40 mm Bofors gun and two 53 cm torpedo tubes. PT-809 was extensively used for technical trials and provided valuable data for th…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉 B-26B
entries.summary: The Douglas A-26 Invader was an American light bomber and attack aircraft used during World War II. It made its first flight on July 10, 1942, and entered service in 1944. In 1948, the U.S. Air Force redesignated all A-26s as B-26s. In 1958, Indonesia first encountered and shot down a B-26B. The aircraft belonged to the CIA, which was supporting local insurgents. Recognizing the bomber’s potential in the war against the insurgents, the Indonesian military ordered six units in 1959 as relations with the U.S. improved. By mid-1960, all six B-26Bs had been…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉M7
entries.summary: In February 1941, the U.S. Army requested a 13-metric-ton light tank with a compact silhouette, a stabilized 37-mm gun, and armor up to 38 mm thick. The first two tanks were the T7 and T7E1, which were to test different features. After reviewing a wooden mockup of the T7 on July 11, the planned weight was increased to 15 metric tons, and the requirements for speed and engine start-up temperatures were relaxed. In August, the program expanded to include five prototypes. The first prototype, the T7, was completed in January 1942 and featured a welded hull…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉J35J
entries.summary: After developing the J35D Draken variant, the Swedes created another variant: the J35F. This new version featured an advanced Mod.67 afterburner and the ability to fire AIM-4 and AIM-26 missiles. It also had a new SAAB S7B fire control system and an IRST from Hughes. Additionally, the pilot’s cockpit visibility was improved, and new instruments and an autopilot were installed. One of the 30-mm cannons was removed and replaced with additional electronics. The first production aircraft entered service in mid-1965, and a total of 208 were built for the Swe…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉F-102A
entries.summary: In October 1948, the U.S. Air Force expressed interest in developing a new radar-equipped fighter interceptor. In January 1950, the military issued requirements for the radar and, in June, for the aircraft itself. Three companies were shortlisted to build the aircraft: Republic, Lockheed, and Convair. Despite its unconventional design featuring a delta wing and a missile bay, Convair's design was selected and designated the XF-102. Initially, the Curtiss-Wright J67 was considered for the interceptor's engine, but due to delays and issues with potential …

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉F-14D (VF-11)
entries.summary: The F-14D Super Tomcat, which entered service with the US Navy in 1991, was the final and most advanced variant of the Grumman F-14 carrier-based interceptor. The VF-11 "Red Rippers" is one of the oldest squadrons in U.S. naval aviation. Reformed from VF-43 in 1959, it operated the F-14A from 1980 onward. In July 1992, the squadron joined Carrier Air Wing 14 and began transitioning to the F-14D at Naval Air Station Miramar. They became one of the first squadrons to operate the latest Tomcat variant. In February 1994, the "Red Rippers" participated in Op…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉T-44 (Be Prepared!)
entries.summary: The T-44 was a Soviet medium tank developed by Design Bureau No. 183 from 1943 to 1944. Experience from the Great Patriotic War showed that T-34 tanks of all variants were extremely vulnerable in battles against German Pz.V Panther or Pz.VI Tiger tanks due to insufficient armor protection. Consequently, the primary objective in designing the new tank, which was later designated the T-44, was to reinforce its armor. Although mass production of the tanks began in late September 1944, a stable production schedule was not established until the end of the ye…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉USS Mahan
entries.summary: The USS Mahan (DD-364) was a United States Navy destroyer and the lead ship of her class. She was named after Rear Admiral Alfred Thayer Mahan, who was a naval theorist and historian. She was was laid down on 12 June 1934, she was launched on 15 October 1935, and she was commissioned on 18 September 1936. Destroyers of this class were designed as an improved version of the Farragut class and featured state-of-the-art machinery. However, the final two ships, the USS Dunlap and the USS Fanning, are often classified as a separate subclass because they were…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉IS-2M (Be Prepared!)
entries.summary: The IS-2M was a Soviet postwar modernization of the IS-2 tank, designed to extend its service life during peacetime. In the 1950s, the IS-2 still constituted a significant portion of the Soviet Army’s combat strength; however, many of its components had become obsolete or were worn out by that point. Therefore, in 1957, a major overhaul and modernization of all in-service tanks began. Specifically, the tanks were fitted with a new engine and transmission; their ammunition load was increased to 35 shells; the driver was equipped with a periscope instead …

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉Object 416
entries.summary: The Object 416 was an experimental Soviet light tank that was later reclassified as an SPG. As early as 1944, the designers at Kharkov Plant No. 75 conducted their first experiments on creating a tank with a rear-mounted turret based on the T-44. In 1950, they revisited the idea with a new design, intending to use a rear-mounted turret to reduce the vehicle's profile while maintaining armor protection. This time, the vehicle was designed to be a light tank. The first prototype of the vehicle was ready in 1951, around the same time that it was redesignat…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉M53/59 (Be Prepared!)
entries.summary: The M53/59, also known as Praga PLDvK vz. 53/59-"Ještěrka" (Praga twin-cannon AA Model 53/59 "Lizard") in Czech, is an ex-Czechoslovak SPAA built from the chassis of a Praga V3S truck with a pair of 30 mm ZK453 autocannon onboard in the second half of 1950s. Although this truck was designed and manufactured by the dawn of supersonic jets, these 30 mm cannons did provide devastating firepower against light targets where it would be hopeless against autocannons. The truck didn't see action in Czechoslovakia (and their successor states) but combat records …

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉Strela
entries.summary: The Strela was a Soviet Fugas-class minesweeper and a Project 53 subtype. She was laid down at Shipyard No. 190 in Leningrad (finished on factory No. 196) on May 10, 1935. She was launched on May 17, 1936, and commissioned on August 13, 1938. The development of this class of minesweepers began in 1930, and the preliminary sketches were ready by October of that year. The preliminary design was approved on April 25, 1931. By the end of the year, the design had been finalized and approved as "Project 3". However, the technical design was not approved until…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉AMV (BMP-3)
entries.summary: The Patria AMV was developed in 2004 as a replacement for the obsolete 6x6 Sisu Pasi. The new vehicle featured an 8x8 chassis configuration, improved mine protection, and stronger armor. Another distinctive feature was its modular design, which allowed the vehicle to serve as a platform for IFVs or assault guns. As early as 2007, designers took advantage of this feature by unveiling an AMV equipped with a BMP-3 turret at the IDEX exhibition in Dubai. However, installing the new combat module required lengthening the vehicle’s hull. Soon after, the UAE o…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉MiG-35
entries.summary: The MiG-35 is an advanced version of the MiG-29M/M2 (Product 9-15) and the carrier-based MiG-29K (9-41), meeting the "4++ generation" standard. The Mikoyan Design Bureau developed the MiG-29M between 1986 and 1991. The aircraft successfully completed testing and received preliminary approval for mass production, but the dissolution of the Soviet Union halted these plans. In the mid-2000s, the idea of developing a new MiG in a modern configuration was revived with the MiG-35 project. The aircraft made its maiden flight on January 26, 2017, and was presen…

entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉S-706
entries.summary: The S-706 was one of the last series of German Schnellboot-type torpedo boats. Built at the Danziger Waggonfabrik shipyard in Danzig, it was launched in 1944 and entered service on October 31st of that year. Compared to the S-100, the late-series boats had two additional torpedo tubes for firing towards the stern while retreating. The artillery armament was also modified closer to the end of the war. The S-706 spent most of its career in the English Channel as well as the North Sea. In particular, it participated in mining the Channel in April 1945. Aft…

The project originated from researchers at the German Aircraft Research Institute (DFS), led by Fritz Stamer, who sought to develop a cargo glider carried under a powered aircraft to extend the glider's flight range. entries.name: 〈wiki·载具简介〉Pbil m/39
entries.summary: The Pansarbil m/39 Lynx is the Swedish designation for an armored car built by Landsverk for the Danish army. Development of the new vehicle began in 1936 when the Swedish Army decided to establish armored brigades equipped with tanks and armored cars. The Pbil m/31 had already become obsolete by then, so a new armored car was needed. Denmark was interested in the Swedish design and ordered 18 vehicles. However, before Denmark was occupied, it had received only three. The remaining 15 were adopted by the Swedish Army in August 1940. Volvo then took over…

entries.name: 〈wiki·系列〉Dark-class motor boat
entries.summary: The Dark-class (or Type A) were a class of British patrol boats in service from 1954 till 1971. It succeeded the Gay-class and was replaced by the Brave-class. Dark-class fast attack boats were designed during the early years of the Cold War as the first diesel-engine vessel of the Royal Navy. It replaced the Gay-class, which was powered by an expensive high-octane fuel, while maintaining the same speed and displacement. entries.name: 〈wiki·武器〉FIM-92 Stinger missile
entries.summary: The FIM-92 Stinger, and its helicopter-mounted counterpart the AIM-92 Air-To-Air Stinger (ATAS), is an American infrared-homing missile. The FIM-92 is also known as the "Fliegerfaust 2 Stinger" in German service. The Stinger is what is commonly known as a MANPADS missile - short for Man-Portable Air Defense System - and was developed to be portable and self-reliant. As such, the missile comes equipped with an Infrared Counter-Countermeasure (IRCCM) seeker, meaning it can reject enemy flares with devastating accuracy and home in straight towards an enemy…

entries.name: 〈wiki·武器〉20 mm M61 cannon
entries.summary: The 20 mm M61 is an American rotary cannon used in their jet aircraft. Renowned for its high rate of fire, the M61 became the standard gun armament for American jet aircraft for many years since its adoption. The M61A1 is an improvement over the original M61 with a new linkless feeding mechanism that reduced malfunctions due to the extreme rate of fire. entries.summary: "The Great War!" event was first shown as part of War Thunder’s annual April Fools’ events, held in 2025. entries.name: 〈wiki·厂商〉K+W
entries.summary: The Swiss company Eidgenössische Konstruktionswerkstätte (K+W) was a state-run enterprise based in Thun and part of the Armament Services Group under the Swiss Federal Military Department (now the DDPS). Its primary mission was to reduce Switzerland’s reliance on imported military equipment and ensure self-sufficiency in times of crisis. The abbreviation “K+W” is official, with the “+” symbolizing the Swiss cross and thus denoting its federal status — a convention also used for other federal enterprises. entries.name: 〈wiki·文章〉Japanese Ground Vehicle History
entries.summary: The development of Japanese armoured vehicles began like many other industrial nations, inspired by the pioneering tanks of World War I. Domestic production started in the late 1920s, with Japan's tanks battle-tested during the Sino-Japanese conflict and the early Pacific campaigns of the 1930s. However, stagnation set in due to budget cuts and turmoil in tactics, leaving Japan's tank forces outdated by World War II. Development in the 1940s was largely defensive, and the tanks on the frontlines were from the 1930s, giving a false impression of Japan’s …

entries.name: 〈wiki·文章〉[History] A7M Reppū
entries.summary: The Mitsubishi A7M, designated as Reppū (烈風, Strong Wind), was a series of Japanese fighter aircraft designed and built by Mitsubishi Aircraft Company during World War II. The A7M was intended to replace the A6M as the Imperial Japanese Navy's main carrier-based fighter. The A7M had a more powerful engine, a larger wing, and improved manoeuvrability and speed than the Zero. However, the A7M faced many technical difficulties and delays, and only a few prototypes were completed before the end of the war. Nicknames: Designation: Reppū (烈風, Strong Wind) All…

It was a much larger aircraft with refined aerodynamics and a monstrously powerful Tumansky R-79 turbofan primary engine. Despite its advanced features, the Sheridan’s combat history is riddled with challenges, from troubles with its radical new armament to its mixed reception in Vietnam. entries.name: 〈wiki·文章〉[History] English Electric Lightning: Britain's Mach 2 Missile
entries.summary: The English Electric Lightning was the RAF’s primary front-line interceptor from its introduction in 1959 up until the mid-1970s when it began to be replaced by the Phantom FGR.2. Even so, the Lightning would continue to serve in the interceptor role with the RAF until 1988, leaving RAF service less than two years before the first Phantoms began to be retired from service. That’s why, in the 1930s the kingdom was just as interested in developing their military capabilities as its neighbours. This reaction time and accuracy between target detection and effective hit draw the line between life and death in tank warfare. entries.name: 〈wiki·文章〉Mortars
entries.summary: A mortar is a type of smoothbore cannon that exclusively uses high-angle plunging fire. It is designed for indirect fire, with projectiles, technically known as bombs, that drop onto targets from above. Mortars are typically smaller, lighter weapon systems with a shorter range compared to other cannons. Compared to howitzers, mortars have a shorter range, lack the ability to fire at a shallow angle, are generally lighter, and have smoothbore rather than rifled barrels. In addition infrared (IR) searchlights were added to tanks which historically had them. entries.summary: The story of the A129 Mangusta began during the late stages of the Cold War. The helicopter was developed at the request of the Italian Army, which saw the need to equip its air units with a dedicated attack helicopter equipped with anti-tank capabilities. The A129 was the first dedicated attack helicopter fully designed and built in Western Europe. Its project began in 1978, and its final design was ready only in 1982. entries.summary: Not only do aircraft have variable thrust vectoring, but so do their missiles! One of these is the SRAAM, which can be found in game on the Hunter F.6 and Harrier GR.1. It was developed by the designers of the British Hawker Siddeley following the results of the use of early air-to-air missiles in Vietnam: they had poor performance at close range due to poor manoeuvrability and a narrow field of view. When Hawker's designers began work on their replacement project, they set out to create a missile that worked the way the pilots wanted it to, rather than…

entries.name: 〈wiki·文章〉Did you know? // Guided APFSDS
entries.summary: You can guide the unguided! In the 1980s, the U.S. Army experimented extensively with anti-tank weapons to replace the older and slower TOW ATGMs. One of the most notable prototypes of the time was the LOSAT missile system developed by Vought. In an effort to increase the missile's range and effectiveness, they proposed using tungsten rod instead of a HEAT warhead. Such a system was the best of both worlds! It had high penetration, ignored ERA, and could be used effectively against moving targets, accelerating to near hypersonic speeds. The complex was …

entries.name: 〈wiki·文章〉Did you know? // Smoke vs Thermals
entries.summary: Smoke grenades and shells not only hide you from the enemy's eyes, but also from their thermals! With the spread of thermal imaging sights, the engineers of various countries came to a common conclusion: it was necessary to somehow hide the tank from the enemy behind smoke screens through which the vehicle could now be seen. Three solutions became the most common: to use red phosphorus with aluminum particles, brass or graphite powder, or titanium dioxide and/or terephthalic acid particles in the composition of shells — aerosol smoke screens of such com…

entries.name: 〈wiki·文章〉Did you know? // Asymmetric Nozzles
entries.summary: The different position of the F-14A engine nozzles in the hangar isn't a bug, it's feature! In real life, F-14s with their engines off look the same. When an engine is shut down, the one engine is turned off first to test the bidirectional pump, ensuring the flight hydraulics still work if that engine fails in flight. After this check, the flight hydraulics are turned off, so the one afterburner nozzle stays open due to no hydraulic power. Another engine continues to power the weight-on-wheels system until it is shut down. When said engine winds down an…

entries.name: 〈wiki·文章〉Did you know? // Hydrofoil
entries.summary: Ships can fly! Kind of. At the beginning of the 20th century, shipbuilders had a simple idea: if you take most of the ship out of the water, you reduce drag and increase speed significantly. The way to do this was borrowed from airplanes — just install a wing that creates a lifting force, in turn pushing the ship out of the water. The Germans with their VS-6 were the first to use hydrofoils on a combat vehicle, but after World War II, ships alike were used all over the world! In War Thunder, every commander of a suitable vehicle can try out hydrofoils: …

entries.name: 〈wiki·文章〉Did you know? // Two Drivers
entries.summary: Your tank might have two drivers! Why? How else could you arrive swiftly, attack the enemy, and retreat quickly, especially when it was the 20th century and rear-view cameras hadn't been invented yet? So many designers of such fast ambush vehicles came to a single decision — to add another driver looking backwards. In addition, this arrangement increased the survivability of the vehicle in combat. And there are many examples of such vehicles in War Thunder: German "Pumas" — Sd.Kfz. 234; the French EBR, which is practically symmetrical from front to rear…

Designed in a matter of weeks, it was meant to be the savior of the crumbling Luftwaffe, a mass-produced miracle piloted by barely trained teenagers. Instead, it became a symbol of the Reich’s technological ambition outstripped by harsh reality, a war machine built in frantic haste as Germany spiraled into defeat. But in the context of regular border clashes, IDF command wanted a more modern and more effective system. The task of creating a “howitzer of the future” was assigned to the engineers at Soltam, who by then already had experience in artillery design. The design process was slow, but the bureau soon acquired a captured German Me 262 Schwalbe ("Swallow"), which profoundly influenced the project's subsequent development. entries.name: 〈优缺点〉[Review] The Mighty Maus
entries.summary: 优点：Excellent survivability - strong protection all-around, nigh indestructible against many guns when angled and at range, very resilient against bombs and rockets；Good traction, will reach its top speed consistently on almost all terrain；Powerful 128mm cannon that's effective against almost all enemies it faces；Coaxial 75mm cannon - Allows the Maus to create a 'smoke wall', or easily overpressure open-top vehicles | 缺点：Slow at everything; Struggles to crest hills quickly, turn the hull/turret quickly；Can be easily overwhelmed without team support；Imposing profile; seen from a mile …

entries.name: 〈优缺点〉The Swedish Kungstiger
entries.summary: 优点：Very good front armor protection；High cannon penetration；Adequate reload；Fast turret rotation | 缺点：Weak turret protection；Low power-to-weight ratio；Massive size；Turret ring is weaker than that of a tank in the german tech tree

entries.name: 〈打法〉The Swedish Kungstiger
entries.summary: Thanks to its powerful cannon, Kungstiger is well suited for the role of a sniper, supporting the advancing allies or preventing enemy attacks in some directions. To do this, you need to find a position with a good view, keep the tank pointed at the enemy, and look around in case the enemy is flanking you. Excellent frontal armor of the hull will protect the tank from most enemy shells, and only the turret is worth worrying about. The most dangerous opponents for this role will be vehicles with large-caliber HE shells or HEAT, armor penetration of which does not decrease with distan…

entries.name: 〈优缺点〉TBD-1 Devastator
entries.summary: 优点：Decent survivability；Big amount of bombs | 缺点：Low max speed；Just a single offensive machine gun

entries.name: 〈打法〉TBD-1 Devastator
entries.summary: In air battles, the TBD-1 torpedo bomber takes the role of a bomber, so the main task will be to attack ground targets: destroying tanks, bunkers and artillery. Due to the plane's spawn at high altitude next to other bombers, you can try to shoot down other planes of your class: after bombing some target, especially a stationary one, you can try to attack some passing bombers. Unfortunately, if the enemy is faster, like the BB-1, or more maneuverable, like the Hs.123A-1 and D3A1, this tactic will not work for the TBD-1, and you will have to move run to allied fighters, hoping for th…

entries.name: 〈优缺点〉M1 KVT
entries.summary: 优点：Excellent mobility and speed；Decent survivability；High targeting speed；Good hull and turret protection | 缺点：It is almost impossible to shoot backwards；Weak hull side protection；Big size；Weak zone between the turret and the hull

entries.name: 〈打法〉M1 KVT
entries.summary: Thanks to the combination of all its features, the M1 KVT effective both in active, aggressive play and in positional, defensive combat. In general, the tank's capabilities in different game modes (arcade, realistic/sim) do not differ significantly — the vehicle allows you to use almost any combat tactics in any game mode. Excellent mobility facilitates active gameplay, allowing you to be in the right place at the right time or to retreat in time to change positions, and the 105 mm cannon's quick reload will allow you to outgun any enemy. In urban maps, the best solution is to get t…

entries.name: 〈优缺点〉The Japanese Type 99 Usage and Characteristics for Ground Battle
entries.summary: 优点：Excellent shell velocity for a self-propelled howitzer；7.5 second reload speed with autoloader；Large crew compartment makes it likely to survive a hit | 缺点：Limited ballistic protection；Large size makes it difficult to hide and conceal；Despite the size, small crew count
aliases: The Japanese Type 99 Usage and Character

entries.name: 〈优缺点〉The MiG-19S - Gameplay Characteristics for Battle
entries.summary: 优点：Three powerful, high-velocity 30 mm cannons；Unparalleled thrust-to-weight ratio, providing excellent acceleration and climb rate；One of the fastest aircraft of its rank；Short take-off run for a high rank jet；Access to a drogue chute for high-speed landings on shorter airfields | 缺点：No air-to-air missiles；Poor ammunition count for cannon armaments；Compresses at high speed, affecting maneuverability；Very susceptible to critical engine damage due to large engine module sizes；No search radar

entries.name: 〈优缺点〉The J22 - Gameplay Characteristics for Battle
entries.summary: 优点：Excellent 13.2 mm armament；Light and nimble | 缺点：No suspended armament options；Poor high-altitude performance
aliases: The J22 - Gameplay Characteristics for B

entries.name: 〈优缺点〉18-inch Mk.7 torpedo (450 mm)
entries.summary: 优点：Low mass | 缺点：Low maximum range；Relatively low speed；Small explosive filler

entries.name: 〈打法〉18-inch Mk.7 torpedo (450 mm)
entries.summary: Much like all lightweight torpedoes, it's best used against large, slow targets with no torpedo defense. When using it, one must remember about the minimum arming distance, which is 50 m, or triple the full length of the PT-3. When faced with multiple fast coastal vessels and no alternative targets, it's worth to just launch torpedoes in a general direction of the enemy vessels — sometimes lucky hits are the best one can hope for.

entries.name: 〈优缺点〉22.5-inch Mk.13, Mk.13-6 and Mk.13-6 Case torpedoes
entries.summary: 优点：Ability to drop from a high altitude and high speed；Long range | 缺点：Aircraft typically only carry one or two at a time；Slow, given enough distance a ship can avoid the torpedo

entries.name: 〈打法〉22.5-inch Mk.13, Mk.13-6 and Mk.13-6 Case torpedoes
entries.summary: The upgraded Mk.13 torpedo can be utilised against any target which is in the water which can include ships, boats, tanks (at the water's edge), boat-planes or even structures. Due to the higher altitude in which it can be dropped from, the delivering bomber can make a safer approach, release and get-away avoiding ship-board anti-aircraft fire and fighters patrolling around ships.

entries.name: 〈优缺点〉SET-40 (400 mm)
entries.summary: 优点：Good travel range；Effective at close range | 缺点：Very small overall weight, size, and explosive charge；Low top speed；No torpedo mode

entries.name: 〈打法〉SET-40 (400 mm)
entries.summary: The SET-40 torpedo can be a very potent weapon in the right situations used against other bluewater ships and even larger coastal vessels. Due to the decent speed one can use them to surprise larger ships coming to coastal spawns in either MPK Pr.12412 or MPK Pr.12412P, or acting as a deterrent holding off certain choke points in the more deep areas while playing the SKR-1 or SKR-7. OTA-40 launcher The torpedoes suffer from having a small calibre and a small warhead, which can lead to situations where hits on other larger ships may not do much damage if not around a ammo rack or eng…

entries.name: 〈优缺点〉610 mm Type 93 torpedo
entries.summary: 优点：Very large explosive mass；Very high top speed | 缺点：Reload is usually required to access all torpedoes；Additional torpedoes are prone to explode

entries.name: 〈打法〉610 mm Type 93 torpedo
entries.summary: One useful feature of the Type 93 torpedo is that on most ships that carry them (with the exception of Shimakaze), extra torpedoes are stored on the ship, which allows the torpedo launchers to be reloaded in battle, usually enough for one full reload of the torpedo launchers. While this does limit the number of torpedoes the ship can send at once, the total amount of torpedoes is often much more than what destroyers and cruisers of other nations can carry. This is useful in Realistic Battles as a single ship can launch multiple salvoes of torpedoes without having to visit a capture …

entries.name: 〈优缺点〉533 mm Mk.IX torpedo
entries.summary: 优点：Above-average 340 kg TNT explosive mass | 缺点：Below-average top speeds (67 km/h and 56 km/h)

entries.name: 〈打法〉533 mm Mk.IX torpedo
entries.summary: Two of the Mk.IX’s specifications are worth noting: the above-average 340 kg TNT warhead and the maximum range of 12.35 km with the Torpedo Mode modification installed. Other than this, the torpedo is unremarkable. The maximum range without the Torpedo Mode modification is 9.6, respectable but unremarkable. The maximum speeds, 67 km/h with the Torpedo Mode modification and 56 km/h without, are on the lower end, but there are many slower torpedoes. For motor torpedo boats and other smaller vessels, the Mk.IX should be used without the Torpedo Mode modification, where the lower maximu…

entries.name: 〈优缺点〉Shimakaze-class destroyer
entries.summary: 优点：Fastest Japanese Bluewater vessel；Three quintuple torpedo launchers；127 mm guns boast good ballistics；Plenty of 25 mm (Good against PTs & Planes) | 缺点：Main guns are secondary to torpedoes；Slow turret traverse and no AP rounds；Turrets are easily disabled；25 mm AA range ( ~3 km)

entries.name: 〈打法〉Shimakaze-class destroyer
entries.summary: Shimakaze is one of Japan's most formidable destroyers, largely due to her impressive torpedo armament, featuring three quintuple launchers. Only the Italian-built Tashkent and the French Le Fantasque class can rival her in terms of speed. While she is well-rounded in survivability and firepower, she lacks AP ammunition, making her vulnerable to gun-centric destroyers and cruisers unless her maneuverability is fully utilized. Nonetheless, cruisers and bigger must still be cautious of Shimakaze's formidable torpedo arsenal, capable of overwhelming them with a single salvo. This often…

entries.name: 〈打法〉Type 97 Chi-Ha Short Gun
entries.summary: The Chi-Ha Short Gun, designed for infantry support, reveals its limitations in tank combat. Its slow turret traverse and poor shell trajectory significantly hinder its effectiveness against armoured targets. However, the HE shells, each containing 2.64 kg of TNT equivalent, can reliably cause overpressure damage, easily neutralizing most lightly armoured vehicles and tanks with less than 30 mm of armour. Against medium and heavy tanks, direct confrontation is ill-advised. Instead, rely on friendly support to handle these threats. In some cases, you might attempt a shot at a weak hu…

entries.name: 〈优缺点〉Kugelblitz – Using a 30 mm Ball Turret on a Panzer IV
entries.summary: 优点：Lethal 30 mm cannons able to take out both air and ground targets；Closed-top construction improves survivability | 缺点：HVAP belt is 2/3 HE shells, limiting overall effectiveness；Roof armor weak to aircraft strafing
aliases: Kugelblitz – Using a 30 mm Ball Turret o

entries.name: 〈优缺点〉AMX-50 (TO90/930) - Flanker Supreme!
entries.summary: 优点：Outstanding mobility；4-second autoloader with 12 rounds in the rack；Has access to APHE shells; one of very few domestic French designs to have it ingame | 缺点：Lacks a stabilizer；Poor armor protection；Lacks alternative shell types (APDS, HEATFS, etc.)

entries.name: 〈优缺点〉Type 90 MBT
entries.summary: 优点：4-Second autoloaded 120 mm cannon；Excellent mobility, High power-to-weight ratio and automatic transmission；Hydropneumatic suspension allows the tank to hide behind low ridges and compensating for its limited -7° gun depression | 缺点：19-shell autoloader is quickly depleted and slow to replenish；Comparatively weak armour to common-faced vehicles；Comparatively slow turret traverse and gun adjustment, with limited elevation/depression angles unless suspension is used

entries.name: 〈打法〉Type 90 MBT
entries.summary: Everything around the Type 90 revolves around its excellent mobility and rapid fire rate. Unfortunately, the Type 90 isn't particularly durable when it comes to absorbing hits; any shot will likely cause significant damage to its modules or crew. As a result, the Type 90 is best suited to flanking positions, with its impressive mobility only outdone by high-speed-focused MBTs like the Ariete AMV. The Type 90 can also act as a sniper, using its Gen 1 thermals and Laser Rangefinder to acquire targets from a distance. When threatened, the Type 90 can rely on its LWS to cue smoke and qu…

entries.name: 〈优缺点〉Char 2C bis - A Blast From the Past
entries.summary: 优点：Huge crew count of 12 placed separately at the front and back；Spacious hull makes it nearly impossible to one-shot unless it is a direct hit on ammo racks；Massive HE shell capable of defeating even modern MBTs；Decent reflex mobility due to neutral steering and reverse gearbox；Good off-road mobility, can climb over hills or obstacles with ease | 缺点：Absurdly huge, easily spotted and targeted by any enemy；Mediocre armor even for its BR, relies on hull space and crew count to survive；Poor shell velocity and long reload time；Very poor top speed of just 15 km/h；Vulnerable to flanking d…
aliases: Char 2C bis - A Blast From the Past

entries.name: 〈优缺点〉Heavy Tank T26E5
entries.summary: 优点：Good armor；Good mobility for a heavy tank；Fast reloading | 缺点：A vulnerable spot in a radio operator’s machine gun；There is always ammunition in the turret；The 90 mm cannon is quite good, but lags behind the German 88 mm or Soviet 122 mm cannon.

entries.name: 〈优缺点〉PLZ05 – Long Live the Artillery Corps
entries.summary: 优点：Devastating firepower with SAPCBC for internal damages to enemies；Good artillery chassis platform with sufficient mobility and hydropneumatic suspension；The earliest vehicle in game to receive spall liner for turret crews | 缺点：Huge profile that can be identified even from kilometers；Large-size autoloader with high chance of detonation once penetrated；Default depression angle doesn’t provide enough line-of-fire at complicated terrain
aliases: PLZ05 – Long Live the Artillery Corps

entries.name: 〈优缺点〉How to fly your J 35A "Draken"
entries.summary: 优点：Access to 4 RB24 air-to-air missiles (Swedish AIM-9Bs)；Good acceleration with a high top speed giving it great climb performance；Superior maneuverability at all speeds；30mm are hard hitting and have a high rate of fire；Low stall speed, giving it great dogfighting capabilities | 缺点：No access to any countermeasures while often facing missiles；Lack of a Radar Warning Receiver；Bleeds energy quickly due its delta wing configuration；Cannon velocity is rather low with a very limited amount of ammunition (100 rounds per gun)；Pulling too hard at lower speed might cause an unrecoverable fl…

entries.name: 〈优缺点〉Soukou-Tei No.4
entries.summary: 优点：High damage from the main gun | 缺点：Very inaccurate main gun；Incredibly slow；Fairly weak, despite the armour；Can't hit anything in wavy waters

entries.name: 〈打法〉Soukou-Tei No.4
entries.summary: Soukou-Tei engaging with its two dual 7.7 mm machine gun turrets This vessel's playstyle is very very similar to the previous model, the 1927- and in much the same vein, because of all the various drawbacks this vessel has, it's hard to pinpoint a truly effective way to play it, as it just does not excel in any capacity. A safe, and arguably effective way to play it is by using it as an escort for some of the larger ships on your team, this works in theory, but in practice a lot of the large support vessels around this battle rating are almost twice as fast as you, so you'll likely …

entries.name: 〈优缺点〉JA37C "Viggen"
entries.summary: 优点：Access to 6 missiles, 2 of which are Rb 71 radar-guided missiles；Large caliber countermeasures；The aircraft can pull a lot of AOA；Low stall speed；PD radar at a BR where most planes have non-PD radars, and a radar gunsight | 缺点：Fuel burn is poor with the afterburner; large amounts of fuel are required to stay airborne for a moderate amount of time；Poor RWR making it difficult to identify threats；Bleeds energy a lot due to the delta wing configuration；Acceleration is not great；Cannon does not have a lot of ammo (150 rounds)

entries.name: 〈优缺点〉Object 292 — the first step into next-generation main battle tanks
entries.summary: 优点：High firepower, with exceptional penetration values. It uses the most powerful APFSDS ammunition in the game, delivering excellent post-penetration effects in a single shot.；High mobility compared to other Soviet designs (e.g., the Soviet T-72 and the Chinese ZTZ-96) and in relation to some Western MBTs (e.g., the Israeli Merkava and the British Challenger 2).；A gas turbine engine, which is relatively quiet at mid-range distances and offers comparable but slightly lower power than the American M1 Abrams, for instance, makes the vehicle ideal for ambushes that require rapid reposi…
aliases: Object 292 — the first step into next-ge

entries.name: 〈优缺点〉A Guide to: The Infamous L.O.S.A.T

entries.summary: 优点：Great firepower；Great mobility | 缺点：Barely any armor to speak of；No autoloader — If the gunner is hit, the reload speed drastically decreases

entries.name: 〈优缺点〉Reinventing the Mirage - The Kfir Canard

entries.name: 〈优缺点〉F-4EJ Kai - The Ultimate Phantom
entries.summary: 优点：AN/APG-66 (F-16) radar with advanced scanning, tracking modes, and strong resistance to notching and chaff.；Strong and plenty of missile suite, 4x AIM-9Ls and 4x AIM-7Fs | 缺点：Poor manoeuvrability and average acceleration/top speed, especially compared to typical opponents；No guided ordnance, reducing ground attack effectiveness

entries.name: 〈打法〉F-4EJ Kai - The Ultimate Phantom
entries.summary: Source: Oversights The F-4EJ Kai is the ultimate Japanese package of the F-4 "Phantom II". Equipped with the same pulse-Doppler radar as on the F-16 "Fighting Falcon", the EJ Kai possesses the ability to use a fantastic radar for its airframe, battle rating, and missile arsenal to employ it in the best possible way, allowing it to quickly lock targets for AIM-9Ls and AIM-7Fs which can guarantee aerial kills above ~20 m ground clearance. entries.name: 〈打法〉Arras — a gem in French coastal tree
entries.summary: As one of the largest vessels in the boat spawn, Arras can dominate most boats contesting capture points. Its limited firing arcs, slow turret traverse, and significant heeling during tight turns make aiming challenging. However, its high muzzle velocity and powerful shells can secure multiple kills when used effectively. Despite its drawbacks, Arras is an excellent vessel. In skilled hands, it can achieve 15+ kills per match. According to StatShark, it consistently ranks among the top five coastal vessels in kills per spawn.
aliases: Arras — a gem in French coastal tree

entries.name: 〈打法〉M-51: The Up-gunned Sherman
entries.summary: With its poor mobility, weak armor and powerful long-range firepower, there are two different ways to use this tank. One playstyle for this vehicle is sniping, using the gun depression and long-range penetration. It can also be played as a support tank, staying behind the front lines and assisting allies in destroying heavily armored targets.

Use the mobility to get into a good position, and then open fire on unsuspecting planes. Be wary when multiple enemies are in the air, however. Due to your low fire rate, dealing with more than one plane is a challenge. One enemy aircraft can steal your attention, leading to an…
